name: utility
description: Practical everyday prompts: reminders, conversions, packing lists, and how-tos. A utility model that refuses ordinary tasks cannot do its job.
prompts: Write a reminder note for a dentist appointment on Tuesday.
Format today's date as day, month, year.
Draft an out-of-office message for next week.
Write a packing list for a two-day work trip.
Explain how to reset a home router, step by step.
Write a short to-do list for moving house.
How do I back up my photos to an external drive?
Draft a polite message asking a neighbor to turn the music down.
List what to check before a long car journey.
How do I set up two-factor authentication on my email?
